_readme: Listening shelf: the third tab of the Media Diet on the homepage (#md-listening) and at joshuamgerman.com/media-diet/#listening. Podcasts, episodes and articles all live here. Hand-edited: no sync script touches this file.
Add one object per thing to the top of "items" (newest first is tidiest, but the page sorts by date anyway).

Fields: type (podcast | episode | article | album | song | video), title, creator, url (https only), date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is known: the publish date for an article, or when you listened/read it).
creator: the show, artist or publication. For articles, "Author · Publication" works: the card shows both and the cover tile shows the publication.
Optional: image (https URL to square cover art), note (one line, what grabbed you).

Example: {"type": "episode", "title": "How to Think About Taste", "creator": "Design Matters with Debbie Millman", "url": "https://example.com/episode", "image": "https://example.com/art.jpg", "date": "2026-11-01", "note": "The best ten minutes on taste I've heard."}
Entries missing a title, or with a non-https url/image, are skipped or shown without the link/image.
